metas.name: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
metas.description: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

metas.name: Overacting
metas.description: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

metas.name: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
metas.description: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

metas.name: Barbie in the Nutcracker
metas.description: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

metas.name: The Birthday​ Gift​
metas.description: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

metas.name: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
metas.description: Second City Television cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

metas.name: Collision Course
metas.description: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

metas.name: You, Me, Us
metas.description: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

metas.name: Surviving Hurricane Otis
metas.description: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

metas.name: Gajab Raat
metas.description: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

metas.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
metas.description: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

metas.name: Seriously Single Too
metas.description: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

metas.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
metas.description: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

metas.name: The Storm
metas.description: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

metas.name: Ranabaali
metas.description: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

metas.name: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
metas.description: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

metas.name: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
metas.description: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

metas.name: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
metas.description: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

metas.name: Reporting Live
metas.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

metas.name: Misty Green
metas.description: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

metas.name: Therapy Done Right
metas.description: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

metas.name: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
metas.description: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

metas.name: Doing Life
metas.description: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

metas.name: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
metas.description: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

metas.name: Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
metas.description: Comedian Dane Cook revisits his climb from stand-up stardom—and a devastating family betrayal that cost him millions—in this candid documentary.

metas.name: Dhoomakethu
metas.description: On the morning of his wedding, 36-year-old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat, and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realising that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself.

metas.name: Dorothy
metas.description: In rural Tamil Nadu, two inseparable childhood friends navigate a world shaped by caste, violence and toxic masculinity, until a compassionate woman enters their lives and quietly challenges the social order around them.

metas.name: UNABOMBER
metas.description: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

metas.name: The Paradise
metas.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

metas.name: Less of a Stranger
metas.description: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.

metas.name: Best of the Best
metas.description: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

metas.name: Lust Stories 3
metas.description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

metas.name: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
metas.description: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

metas.name: Gentle Monster
metas.description: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

metas.name: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
metas.description: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

metas.name: The Good Lawyer
metas.description: After a courtroom overdose lands him in rehab, a lawyer has one week to save his career and prepare for his own trial, with the help of a dogged intern.

metas.name: Go Team!
metas.description: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: After her husband's tragic death, Aleena joins the police force through a compassionate appointment. What begins as a quiet new chapter soon turns into a high-stakes battle of wits and courage, testing everything she believes about justice, loyalty, and herself.

metas.name: El Club del Pie Izquierdo
metas.description: A forty-year-old office worker of Mexico City, realizes that he has been trapped in a car and a desk for years. He finds a dance academy, enrolls in reggaeton classes with strict teacher Paulina, and finds renewal. Remake of the Japanese film 'Shall We Dance?'

metas.name: Mandaadi
metas.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

metas.name: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
metas.description: Mr. T took the world by storm as an '80s icon. This documentary reveals the full story behind the mohawk, chains and catchphrase from the man himself.

metas.name: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
metas.description: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

metas.name: Why Did I Get Married Again?
metas.description: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

metas.name: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
metas.description: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

metas.name: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
metas.description: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

metas.name: Gandhari
metas.description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

metas.name: My Best Friend
metas.description: When empty nest syndrome hits, two BFFs follow their teen daughters to Portugal and find love, fun and a whole new meaning of friendship along the way.

metas.name: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
metas.description: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

metas.name: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
metas.description: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

metas.name: Call My Agent! The Movie
metas.description: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

metas.name: The Secret Woman
metas.description: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

metas.name: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
metas.description: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

metas.name: Modha Rathri
metas.description: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

metas.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
metas.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

metas.name: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
metas.description: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

metas.name: Irumudi
metas.description: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

metas.name: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
metas.description: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

metas.name: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
metas.description: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: This, That, and Everything in Between
metas.description: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

metas.name: Don't Say Good Luck
metas.description: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

metas.name: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
metas.description: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

metas.name: Sacrifice
metas.description: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.

metas.name: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
metas.description: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

metas.name: THE RIBBON HERO
metas.description: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

metas.name: Korean Kanakaraju
metas.description: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

metas.name: The Last House
metas.description: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

metas.name: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
metas.description: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

metas.name: Inside the Trustor Scandal
metas.description: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

metas.name: Storm on Sesame Street
metas.description: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

metas.name: A Child of My Own
metas.description: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

metas.name: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
metas.description: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

metas.name: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
metas.description: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

metas.name: The Truthers
metas.description: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

metas.name: Love in Slow Motion
metas.description: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
metas.description: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

metas.name: The Debt Collector
metas.description: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

metas.name: 72 HOURS
metas.description: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

metas.name: Me Before Me
metas.description: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

metas.name: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
metas.description: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Ikka
metas.description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

metas.name: Idhayam Murali
metas.description: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

metas.name: Dhamaal 4
metas.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: After her fiance sleeps with his celebrity crush, Kansas hairdresser Gail heads to Hollywood to even the score with her own famous fantasy — Jon Hamm.

metas.name: Nothing to Lose
metas.description: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

metas.name: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
metas.description: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

metas.name: One Piece Heroines
metas.description: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

metas.name: Baby Do Die Do
metas.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

metas.name: Gatta Kusthi 2
metas.description: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

metas.name: 23 000 Lives
metas.description: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

metas.name: Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: Alpha
metas.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

metas.name: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
metas.description: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

metas.name: Enola Holmes 3
metas.description: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

metas.name: Con City
metas.description: Saravana, Mithra, Jacky, and Janaki, are skilled con artists hiding out as an ordinary family in Mulki, Karnataka. Their quiet life shatters when a young boy in their care is kidnapped, forcing them to use their old hustles one last time.

metas.name: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
metas.description: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

metas.name: Cocktail 2
metas.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

metas.name: Here the Whole Time
metas.description: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

metas.name: Little Brother
metas.description: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

metas.name: Husbands in Action
metas.description: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

metas.name: Stop! That! Train!
metas.description: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

metas.name: Maternal Instinct
metas.description: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

metas.name: Garuda: Dare to Dream
metas.description: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

metas.name: Main Vaapas Aaunga
metas.description: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

metas.name: Kijsada Paradise
metas.description: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

metas.name: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
metas.description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

metas.name: Sing Geetham
metas.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

metas.name: Colors of Evil: Black
metas.description: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

metas.name: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
metas.description: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

metas.name: Carolina Caroline
metas.description: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

metas.name: The Marked Woman
metas.description: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

metas.name: Poldi
metas.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
metas.description: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

metas.name: Office Romance
metas.description: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

metas.name: Wild Sing
metas.description: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

metas.name: Peddi
metas.description: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

metas.name: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
metas.description: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: The Breadwinner
metas.description: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

metas.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
metas.description: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

metas.name: Susana and Elvira: No Plan B
metas.description: Susana and Elvira, two former best friends, reunite after two years apart to organize the celebrity wedding of the year.

metas.name: Blast
metas.description: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

metas.name: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
metas.description: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

metas.name: Mexico 86
metas.description: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

metas.name: Ladies First
metas.description: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

metas.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
metas.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

metas.name: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
metas.description: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

metas.name: Bride of the Year
metas.description: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

metas.name: Kartavya
metas.description: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

metas.name: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
metas.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

metas.name: LifeHack
metas.description: A thrill-seeking gang of teen hackers must pull off their riskiest heist yet when a woman blackmails them into targeting her crypto-billionaire father.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

metas.name: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
metas.description: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.

metas.name: Midnight Girls
metas.description: Set in Nagoya, Japan, four Filipina entertainers form a sisterhood while facing the emotional cost of their jobs. Together, they must decide what they are truly willing to sacrifice for their dreams in a foreign land.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Jamie Vardy
metas.description: From part-time footballer to Premier League legend, this is the story of Jamie Vardy's unprecedented path and his rise to the top against all odds.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.

metas.name: The Roast of Kevin Hart
metas.description: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

metas.name: Daadi Ki Shaadi
metas.description: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

metas.name: Desire
metas.description: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

metas.name: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory
metas.description: Follows Brazil's journey to winning its fourth World Cup in 1994, featuring interviews with players and unseen behind-the-scenes footage from the tournament.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: My Dearest Assassin
metas.description: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

metas.name: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
metas.description: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

metas.name: You, Always
metas.description: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

metas.name: Raja Shivaji
metas.description: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

metas.name: Swapped
metas.description: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

metas.name: Dilan 1997
metas.description: Dilan is an ITB student who returned from Cuba in March 1997. In the midst of the heated political situation leading up to the Reformation.

metas.name: Kara
metas.description: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.

metas.name: Je m'appelle Agneta
metas.description: Craving a fresh start, recently unemployed Agneta accepts an au pair gig in Provence that turns into an indulgent escape — and an unexpected awakening.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.

metas.name: Daddy's in Trouble
metas.description: Roberta is tired of taking care of the house and the kids all by herself, so she decides to take a vacation, leaving her husband to look after the children. The result is that the house is turned upside down as Fred tries to balance family demands with his work responsibilities. Amid laughter and chaos, the film shows how a family can overcome challenges when they stick together.

metas.name: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
metas.description: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.

metas.name: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill
metas.description: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.

metas.name: KillTonyMania
metas.description: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

metas.name: Son-in-Law
metas.description: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

metas.name: Lorne
metas.description: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

metas.name: My Dearest Señorita
metas.description: A young woman from a traditional family learns she's intersex, sparking a journey of self-discovery, gender identity and love found in unexpected places.

metas.name: Mile End Kicks
metas.description: Grace Pine, a 24-year-old music critic, moves to Montreal to write a book on Alanis Morissette's Jagged Little Pill, but her plans are complicated when she becomes romantically involved with two members of an indie band she is covering and decides to become their publicist.

metas.name: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
metas.description: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

metas.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
metas.description: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.

metas.name: Bhooth Bangla
metas.description: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, but strange supernatural events and panicked locals force him to investigate the property's mysterious past.

metas.name: Brawlers
metas.description: Naïm is a sweetheart in everyday life but a beast when it comes to fighting. To afford treatment for his aging dog, he's forced to join "Hello Brawl", a service of street fighters resolving conflicts with punches.

metas.name: Toaster
metas.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

metas.name: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
metas.description: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

metas.name: Untold: Jail Blazers
metas.description: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

metas.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
metas.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

metas.name: Roommates
metas.description: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

metas.name: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam
metas.description: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.

metas.name: 18th Rose
metas.description: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.

metas.name: Thrash
metas.description: When a catastrophic hurricane slams a coastal town, stranded residents must survive rapidly rising waters swarming with ravenous sharks.

metas.name: Sheng Wang: Purple
metas.description: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

metas.name: Untold: Chess Mates
metas.description: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.

metas.name: Sniper: No Nation
metas.description: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.

metas.name: Feel My Voice
metas.description: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.
